name: Ambrose
summary: Ambrose is a fun, inspiring game made for players who thrive for fun and experience. Ambrose was designed for fun and wasn't intended on a bad experienced gameplay. The game includes many different cosmetics to try on and show off to your friends! Join your favorite servers with your friends and have fun! Choose a color that suits your skin! Spend your Bananas all day, and most of all, Have Fun.
